title: Sui Hashi Indexer
description: Health, sync and Hashi state of the Hashi indexer (hashi_indexer_* metrics, collected by the Moonlet agent from port 9199).

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since the indexer process started.

panels.title: Jobs
panels.description: Whether the last run of each job succeeded.

panels.title: Reading Sui
panels.description: Every event type has reached the end of the chain (a run that stops at its page limit shows NO).

panels.title: History stored
panels.description: Every event type has its history window stored.

panels.title: Time since last successful run
panels.description: Alerts fire when events pass 15 minutes or the snapshot passes 40 minutes.

panels.title: Events stored
panels.description: New events read from Sui and stored.

panels.title: Hashi state (as of the last snapshot)
Backing
panels.description: Reserve divided by supply: anything under 100% is worth a look.

panels.title: Newest stored event
panels.description: Age of the newest event per type. A quiet type can be old without any problem: see 'Reading Sui' for sync.
